senses.gloss:
स्थेमन्, आ, m. (according to some), firmness,
stability, fixedness.

स्थेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed or fixed, to be
settled or determined; (अस्), m. a person chosen to
settle a dispute between two parties, an arbitrator,
umpire, judge; a domestic priest; (आस्), f. pl., scil.
आपः, standing water (i. e. water standing in a pot
used in certain nuptial ceremonies).
स्थेय स्थेय, स्थेयस्, स्थेष्ठ. See p. 1147.

स्थेयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of स्थिर), more
fixed or firm, firmer; very firm or stable; eternal,
permanent; very resolute.

स्थेष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, (superl. of स्थिर), most
fixed, very firm or stable, durable.
